name: stark-codex
description: Anti-slop UI/UX design plugin for Codex. Routes product flows, web, Windows, Apple, Android, cross-platform, and token requests to opinionated design skills that ask for UX, platform, track, and direction before code.

interface.shortDescription: Opinionated multi-platform UI/UX design skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: stark helps Codex avoid generic AI UI output by asking for the right product flow, platform, native/cross-platform track, and web aesthetic direction before generating code. It includes UX, web, Windows, Apple, Android, cross-platform design, and design-token skills, plus references, examples, and scripts.
defaultPrompt: Improve the onboarding UX for this app.
Audit this UI for AI slop.
